LESSON: SKIMMING FOR INFORMATION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Reading 2.2 Speed Reading (2 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, the learner
Topic 2.3: Skimming for information

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Skimming for information. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to know the meaning of words being read?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main information in given texts for comprehension
2. read texts fluently for communication

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the main information in given texts for comprehension
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the main information in given texts for comprehension. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. read texts fluently for communication
   In simple words: practise until you can read texts fluently for communication. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Skimming for information using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Skimming for information in the examples.
2. Explain Skimming for information to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Skimming for information.
4. Show that you can: identify the main information in given texts for comprehension

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Skimming for information using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Skimming for information important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read flashcards about animals for the partner to guess the animal (z.B. miaut – Katze; lange Nase – Elefant; Eier – Huhn, usw),
2. Read brief descriptions of animal and the rest guess (z.B. Ich bin groß und habe große Ohren – Elefant; Ich bin braun und habe viele Haare - Löwe; Ich gebe Milch – Kuh; usw),

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main information in given texts for comprehension
2. read texts fluently for communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
